findings.summary: The evaluated diff satisfies the approved precedence invariant: canonical close evidence produces a terminal local route before stale PR metadata, while a non-finalized OPEN task retains the existing behavior.
findings.broken_invariant: External EVALUATOR review requires evidence-backed semantic judgement.

missing_tests: A route-level assertion for the stale CLOSED variant would strengthen coverage; the current positive stale OPEN test exercises the same shared precedence branch.
hidden_assumptions: A canonical task-close commit present on the configured base branch is authoritative local lifecycle evidence even when stale metadata cannot supply the provider merge commit SHA.
